instrument.name: Mini-IPIP-20
instrument.recommended_citation: Donnellan, M. B., Oswald, F. L., Baird, B. M., & Lucas, R. E. (2006). The Mini-IPIP scales: Tiny-yet-effective measures of the Big Five factors of personality. Psychological Assessment, 18, 192-203. https://doi.org/10.1037/1040-3590.18.2.192
instrument.chinese_translation_note: The project Simplified Chinese wording is an independent draft based on the public-domain English items. A Chinese Mini-IPIP was translated, back-translated, and validated in Li et al. (2012), but that publication is not an IPIP-project-certified official edition and its wording is not copied here.
instrument.construct_note: The source labels Factor V Intellect or Imagination. Factor IV is scored as Neuroticism, the reverse orientation of Emotional Stability.

scoring.scale_sum_formula: sum(keyed_value for the four items assigned to the trait)
scoring.interpretation_boundary: Raw sums and means only; do not report percentiles or population labels without a validated target-population norm.

items.en: Am the life of the party.
items.zh_cn_draft: 你常常是聚会中活跃气氛的人。
你能体会并同情他人的感受。
你会及时把该做的日常事务完成。
你的情绪经常起伏。
你有丰富而生动的想象力。
你平时话不多。

items.en: Am not interested in other people's problems.
items.zh_cn_draft: 你对别人的困难不太感兴趣。

items.en: Often forget to put things back in their proper place.
items.zh_cn_draft: 你常忘记把东西放回原位。

items.en: Am relaxed most of the time.
items.zh_cn_draft: 大多数时候，你很放松。

items.en: Am not interested in abstract ideas.
items.zh_cn_draft: 你对抽象的想法不太感兴趣。

items.en: Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
items.zh_cn_draft: 在聚会上，你会和许多不同的人交谈。
你能感受到他人的情绪。
你喜欢井然有序。
你很容易感到烦乱或不安。
你很难理解抽象的想法。
在人群中，你通常待在不显眼的位置。

items.en: Am not really interested in others.
items.zh_cn_draft: 你其实不太关心别人。
你常把事情或环境弄得一团乱。
你很少感到低落。

items.en: Do not have a good imagination.
items.zh_cn_draft: 你的想象力不太丰富。
